turns.text: Hello, this is the fraud investigation desk. May I speak with the account holder?
Hello. Yes, I am the account holder. What happened?
We noticed a suspicious transaction associated with your account earlier today.
That sounds concerning. I did not authorize a new transaction.
I am an investigator assigned to the case. This is a confidential review.
Can I call my bank using the number on my card to confirm?
No. Do not tell your family or anyone at the bank. Keep this call confidential.
I need to know how to protect my money.
The investigation office has instructed you to transfer your savings to a secure holding account.
Are you asking me to transfer all of my money to another account?
Yes, immediately. The deadline is today and there is no time to verify separately.
I am not comfortable doing that without confirmation.
Go to your bank right now. Stay on the line while you travel.
I am walking toward the bank and I can see the entrance.
Do not discuss this investigation with the teller. Say it is a personal transfer.
I am near the bank. What if I speak with a bank employee?
You must follow my instructions or your account could be frozen.
I am at the bank entrance and I have opened my banking application.
Send the money now. Make the transfer to the safe account immediately.
I will stop and independently verify through my bank official phone number.
